description: Allowlisted local tasks dispatched by the CodeFEDDY Control Plane. PowerShell is retained for Windows-only operations; terminal/profile recovery uses Python for deterministic JSON, image generation, validation, and rollback.

google-cloud-support-access.title: Grant the Clintware support Google account access to the existing Google Cloud project

finish-google-oauth.title: Finish Clintware Google OAuth and delegated Gmail/Calendar authorization

python-runtime-check.title: Verify Python execution through Quillgeist Lite

c-runtime-check.title: Verify compiled C execution through Quillgeist Lite

ensure-c-runtime.title: Ensure an approved C compiler is available on Windows

self-update.title: Update Quillgeist Lite runner from the maintained Clintware repository and restart it safely

apply-terminal-glass.title: Rebuild and verify the Quillgeist Lite Windows Terminal profile and retro DOS boot artwork with Python

connect-jira.title: Connect Jira to the CodeFEDDY Control Plane with Atlassian OAuth

enable-admin-console.title: Upgrade qq to the supervised interactive admin console

bootstrap-admin-console.title: Install or repair the qq service and reopen the supervised admin console

repair-local-service.title: Repair the qq Windows health service and stale scheduled-task recovery

gimp-clintware-eclipse.title: Install the deterministic Clintware eclipse GIMP plug-in, render a fresh editable logo, save XCF/PNG, and show it in GIMP

codefeddy-access-check.title: Check local CodeFEDDY GitHub write access and Cloudflare/Wrangler authentication

provision-codefeddy-platform.title: Provision the isolated CodeFEDDY control plane and dedicated qq in codeFEDDY/codeFEDDY.github.io

emergency-recover.title: Stop a qq restart loop, refresh canonical local files, rebuild the terminal profile, and verify a live runner

ensure-powershell.title: Install or upgrade PowerShell 7 and return the current pwsh runtime

update-powerchatbridge.title: Refresh the installed private PowerChatBridge module and restart detected bridge instances

restart-window.title: Restart the visible Quillgeist Lite window and rerun the maintained launcher splash
